source.title: Systemic corticosteroids in critical illness: an evidence-based framework for clinical decision-making
source.whyItFits: Open review that synthesises corticosteroid evidence in severe community-acquired pneumonia, including the CAPE COD hydrocortisone trial and the advice against routine steroids in influenza-associated ARDS. The 2019 ATS/IDSA CAP guideline is also in PMC but predates CAPE COD and recommends against routine steroids; it was not used as the teaching source.

notes: Rejected the stored 2025 CAP update abstract: it states that steroids may be used in severe CAP and not in non-severe CAP, but it is a short summary and does not carry trial figures. Rejected COVID-19 hydrocortisone papers as a different disease.
